diagnostic_evidence.quote: where for the last steps we recall that the normal derivative of the fundamental solution is non-negative (see calculations for the potential above).

issues.failure_explanation: Even if each normal derivative were nonnegative, their difference D Phi need not be nonnegative. Thus the norm of an integral against an arbitrary density error cannot be bounded by the norm of the signed integral of D Phi; cancellations can make the latter small or zero while the former is nonzero. The required quantity is an integral of the absolute value, or another valid operator norm. The analogous fourth-term estimate also assumes a sign not stated for the theorem's general geometry.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Redo the estimates with absolute-kernel or appropriate operator norms and establish that the resulting constants are finite uniformly over the claimed domain.

issues.title: The error theorem bounds signed kernels by their signed integrals
issues.why_classification: A comparable bound may survive, but it needs a corrected nontrivial operator estimate and potentially different constants.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Notice that we can decompose the error into a component arising from the fixed point iterations and another due to the neural network approximation by writing $\left\|\tilde{u}_n - u \right\|_{\Omega} \leq \left\|\tilde{u}_n - u_n \right\|_{\Omega} + \left\|u_n - u \right\|_{\Omega}$.
\State {Step 1. Construct the PDE (\ref{iteration}) with source term $\psi_n(x) := -\lambda u_n(x) + F(x,u_n(x))$.}

issues.failure_explanation: Each approximate iterate is used to construct the next source, so its PFNN error propagates into all subsequent iterates. A one-step error epsilon generally yields a recurrence e_{n+1} <= q e_n + epsilon and hence a geometric sum epsilon(1-q^n)/(1-q), not a single additive epsilon. The proof compares the approximate iterate only with an exact sequence u_n and never controls the discrepancy between the source generated from the approximate previous iterate and the source of that exact sequence.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Establish a one-step stability estimate for the approximate PFNN update and solve the resulting perturbed-contraction recurrence, including iteration-dependent PFNN errors if applicable.
issues.overall_effect: Both the interior and boundary RPFNN error guarantees can underestimate the accumulated numerical error, especially when q is close to one.
issues.title: Per-iteration PFNN errors are not accumulated in the recurrent bound
issues.why_classification: A comparable convergence result may remain, but it requires a new perturbation argument and generally worsens the constant by a factor of order 1/(1-q).
